VOLIBEAR-STACK.maximum: Cost reductions do not stack; the highest value applies.
VOLIBEAR-STACK.charge: {Amount} total Storm Charge, increasing each hit of Lightning damage by {Amount}.
VOLIBEAR-STACK.gainStrength: Gain {Amount} Strength this turn; lose {Amount} Strength at the end of your turn.
VOLIBEAR-STACK.loseStrength: Lose {Amount} Strength this turn; regain {Amount} Strength at the end of your turn.
VOLIBEAR-STACK.armor: Whenever you deal Lightning damage, gain {Amount} total base Block across {Count} triggers ({Values}).
VOLIBEAR-ENGAGE.title: Engage
VOLIBEAR-ENGAGE.description: Force the target to immediately execute its current intent.
VOLIBEAR-DOMAIN.title: Domain
VOLIBEAR-DOMAIN.description: Deploy for the specified number of rounds, each lasting until after you draw next turn. While active, enemy special abilities and your debuffs are disabled; whenever you draw a Status or Curse, Exhaust it and draw 1 card; whenever you play an Attack, deal 3 Lightning damage to ALL enemies.
VOLIBEAR-SUPPRESSION.title: Domain Suppression
VOLIBEAR-SUPPRESSION.description: Suppresses beneficial enemy special effects such as revival, protective phases, damage caps, untargetability, and applying debuffs to the player. Preserves normal attacks, existing Strength/Block, and directly gained Strength/Block.
VOLIBEAR-ABSORPTION.title: Absorption
VOLIBEAR-ABSORPTION.description: The total amount of damage actually blocked by the initiator's Block during this Engage.
VOLIBEAR-LIGHTNING.title: Lightning damage
VOLIBEAR-LIGHTNING.description: Spell damage amplified by Storm Charge.
VOLIBEAR-THUNDER_FORCE.title: Storm Charge
VOLIBEAR-THUNDER_FORCE.description: Each point increases every hit of Lightning damage by 1.
VOLIBEAR-THUNDER_SPELL.title: Lightning Skill
VOLIBEAR-THUNDER_SPELL.description: A Skill whose card text directly deals Lightning damage.
VOLIBEAR-BEASTIFY.title: Beastify
VOLIBEAR-BEASTIFY.description: Exhaust the original card and generate a new Beast Form card: Attacks become Bone-Rending Claw; other cards become Storm Body.
VOLIBEAR-BEAST_FORM.title: Beast Form
VOLIBEAR-BEAST_FORM.description: Collective term for Bone-Rending Claw (Claw Form) and Storm Body (Body Form). Inherits upgrades from the original card and Exhausts when played.
VOLIBEAR-BITE.title: Bite Mark
VOLIBEAR-BITE.description: A mark left on the target when hit by Frenzied Maul.
VOLIBEAR-RETALIATE.title: Thunder Retaliation
VOLIBEAR-RETALIATE.description: Whenever you take an enemy Attack Hit, deal the specified Lightning damage to the attacker.
VOLIBEAR-PREPARE.title: Prime
VOLIBEAR-PREPARE.description: Increases each hit of Attack damage by the specified amount the next time the designated card is played.
VOLIBEAR-TRAIN.title: Hone
VOLIBEAR-TRAIN.description: Increases each hit of the designated card's own Attack and Lightning damage by the specified amount for the rest of combat.
VOLIBEAR-REPLAY.title: Replay
VOLIBEAR-REPLAY.description: Resolves the full card effect an additional time.
VOLIBEAR-DRAIN.title: Drain
VOLIBEAR-DRAIN.description: Heals HP equal to the actual unblocked damage dealt.
VOLIBEAR-RETAIN_BLOCK.title: Block Retention
VOLIBEAR-RETAIN_BLOCK.description: At the start of your turn, instead of losing all Block, lose at most the specified amount.
VOLIBEAR-UNBREAKABLE.title: Unbreakable Armor
VOLIBEAR-UNBREAKABLE.description: After taking an attack, your Block remains unchanged; damage exceeding Block still reduces HP.
VOLIBEAR-PURIFY.title: Purifying Exhaust
VOLIBEAR-PURIFY.description: Nullifies the selected Status or Curse card's own effect before Exhausting it.
VOLIBEAR-RETRIEVE.title: Search
VOLIBEAR-RETRIEVE.description: Choose a qualifying card from your Draw Pile and add it to your hand.
VOLIBEAR-RECOVER.title: Retrieve
VOLIBEAR-RECOVER.description: Choose a qualifying card from your Discard Pile and add it to your hand.
VOLIBEAR-DISCOUNT.title: Cost Reduction
VOLIBEAR-DISCOUNT.description: Reduces the Energy cost of the designated card.
VOLIBEAR-THUNDER_ARMOR.title: Thunder Armor
VOLIBEAR-THUNDER_ARMOR.description: Whenever you deal Lightning damage, gain the specified amount of Block. Each hit of AoE Lightning damage counts once.
VOLIBEAR-ORDINARY_SEGMENT.title: Attack Hit
VOLIBEAR-ORDINARY_SEGMENT.description: Each individual hit of a multi-hit attack is calculated separately; a single hit striking multiple enemies still counts as one Attack Hit.
VOLIBEAR-LIGHTNING_COUNT.title: Lightning Damage Count
VOLIBEAR-LIGHTNING_COUNT.description: Each hit of Lightning damage counts once, including each hit of AoE Lightning damage. Resets at the start of next turn.
VOLIBEAR-DEPLOYMENT.title: Power Stacking
VOLIBEAR-DEPLOYMENT.description: Playing multiple copies of the same Power triggers each copy separately and tracks their counts independently.
VOLIBEAR-ATTACK_HISTORY.title: Cards Played
VOLIBEAR-ATTACK_HISTORY.description: Increments once each time an Attack card is played; Replay does not add extra counts. Resets at the start of next turn.
VOLIBEAR-ENEMY-SUMMON.title: Summon
VOLIBEAR-ENEMY-SUMMON.description: Calls forth new enemies. Enemies cannot be summoned while Domain is active, though already summoned enemies continue to fight.
VOLIBEAR-ENEMY-HATCH.title: Hatch & Transform
VOLIBEAR-ENEMY-HATCH.description: Transforms into another form upon death or entering a new phase. Cannot hatch, transform, or revive while Domain is active.
VOLIBEAR-ENEMY-FLEE.title: Fat Gremlin Escape
VOLIBEAR-ENEMY-FLEE.description: Flees from combat. Cannot flee while Domain is active.
VOLIBEAR-ENEMY-CARD_THEFT.title: Card Theft
VOLIBEAR-ENEMY-CARD_THEFT.description: Steals your cards, potentially permanently. Cannot steal cards while Domain is active.
VOLIBEAR-ENEMY-GOLD_THEFT.title: Gold Theft
VOLIBEAR-ENEMY-GOLD_THEFT.description: Steals your Gold. Cannot steal Gold while Domain is active; defeating the enemy still recovers previously stolen Gold.
VOLIBEAR-ENEMY-STATUS_CARDS.title: Harmful Status Cards
VOLIBEAR-ENEMY-STATUS_CARDS.description: Adds Status cards into your deck. Cannot add them while Domain is active.
VOLIBEAR-ENEMY-SANDPIT.title: Quicksand & Devour
VOLIBEAR-ENEMY-SANDPIT.description: Quicksand pulls you deeper, devouring you when the countdown reaches zero. Domain pauses the countdown and pull while disabling Devour; the countdown resumes after Domain ends.
VOLIBEAR-ENEMY-KNOWLEDGE.title: Lore Restriction
VOLIBEAR-ENEMY-KNOWLEDGE.description: Choose between taking ongoing damage, drawing fewer cards, play limits, or reduced Energy. These debuffs are suspended while Domain is active; unexpired effects resume after Domain ends.
VOLIBEAR-ENEMY-KNIGHTS.title: Knight's Restriction
VOLIBEAR-ENEMY-KNIGHTS.description: Suppresses card upgrades and grants cards Ethereal. While Domain is active, suppressed upgrades are restored and Ethereal granted by this effect is disabled; remaining restrictions resume after Domain ends. Upgrades gained during Domain are kept.
VOLIBEAR-CONTRIBUTION-ATTACK_BONUS: Bonus attack damage is disabled by Domain.
VOLIBEAR-CONTRIBUTION-BLOCK_RETENTION: Retaining Block between turns is disabled by Domain.
VOLIBEAR-CONTRIBUTION-MITIGATION: Damage reduction and damage caps are disabled by Domain.
VOLIBEAR-CONTRIBUTION-ARTIFACT: Effects that block debuffs are disabled by Domain.
VOLIBEAR-CONTRIBUTION-RETALIATION: Thorns and reflected damage are disabled by Domain.
VOLIBEAR-CONTRIBUTION-PASSIVE_STRENGTH: Passive Strength gain is disabled by Domain.
VOLIBEAR-CONTRIBUTION-CRAB_RAGE: Gaining Strength and Block upon death is disabled by Domain.
VOLIBEAR-CONTRIBUTION-PASSIVE_BLOCK: Passive Block gain is disabled by Domain.
VOLIBEAR-CONTRIBUTION-REVIVAL: Revival, reassembly, and death protection are disabled by Domain.
VOLIBEAR-CONTRIBUTION-STEAM: Steam Phase and revival protection are disabled by Domain.
VOLIBEAR-CONTRIBUTION-DEATH_SUMMON: Summoning enemies upon death is disabled by Domain.
VOLIBEAR-CONTRIBUTION-GOLD_THEFT: Stealing Gold is disabled by Domain.
VOLIBEAR-CONTRIBUTION-CARD_THEFT: Stealing cards is disabled by Domain.
VOLIBEAR-CONTRIBUTION-STATUS: Adding harmful Status cards is disabled by Domain.
VOLIBEAR-CONTRIBUTION-GALVANIC: Bonus damage triggered by Status cards is disabled by Domain.
VOLIBEAR-CONTRIBUTION-VITAL_SPARK: Damage reduction from Status cards is disabled by Domain.
VOLIBEAR-CONTRIBUTION-PAPER_CUTS: Effects that reduce Max HP are disabled by Domain.
VOLIBEAR-ENGAGE_STATE.title: Current Round Engage Info
VOLIBEAR-ENGAGE_STATE.empty: All living enemies have not acted yet this round.
VOLIBEAR-ENGAGE_STATE.spent: These enemies have already acted this round and cannot be Engaged again: {Enemies}.
VOLIBEAR-DISABLED.enemyDescription: This enemy's special mechanics are disabled by Domain; normal attacks still apply.
VOLIBEAR-DISABLED.selfDescription: Debuffs are suspended and restricted abilities are restored. Durations continue to tick down normally; unexpired statuses resume after Domain ends.
